title: Wetlands Lost 35% While Forests Lost Less
hook: Wetlands disappeared nearly three times faster than forests.
closing: Wetlands protect water and absorb floods, so their loss reaches everyone.
question: Is there a wetland near you?

segments.say: Wetland extent fell to an index of 65. The world's natural water buffers keep shrinking.
Wetlands lost 35% of their extent. Their decline far outpaced forests.
Europe lost 50% of its wetlands. It had the steepest regional decline shown.
